headline: Equifax Canada Survey Shows One in Four Canadians Expect to Make Only Minimum Credit Card Payments
summary: More consumers are using credit and savings for everyday expenses, as households with children and adults under 55 report sharper financial pressuresTORONTO, Aug. 06, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- A recent Equifax Canada survey* of over 1,500 Canadians revealed that nearly one in four Canadians say they expect to make only minimum monthly credit card payments, which may indicate increased pressure on household finances.
